text.setup: Hold the bar with an overhand grip just outside your thighs. Hinge forward until your torso is at about 45 degrees, knees soft, back flat.
cues: Pull the bar to your lower ribs, leading with the elbows.
Pause briefly, then lower to straight arms.
Keep the torso angle fixed.
mistakes: Standing up more on every rep to swing the weight.
Rounding the lower back.

text.setup: Load the free end of a landmine bar and straddle it. Hook a V-handle under the bar just behind the plates, hinge forward and grip it.
cues: Pull the plates towards your chest.
Lower until the arms are straight without letting the back round.
mistakes: Jerking the weight up with the hips.

text.setup: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a bench or a sturdy box, the other foot on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with the arm hanging straight.
cues: Pull the dumbbell towards your hip.
Keep your shoulders square to the floor.
Lower until the arm is straight and feel the stretch.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to heave the weight up.

text.setup: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie face down on it with your chest at the top edge, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
cues: Row both dumbbells up, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Keep your chest on the pad.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench to cheat the weight up.

text.setup: Take a staggered stance and rest your free forearm on your front thigh. Hold the kettlebell below your shoulder.
cues: Row the bell to your hip.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting.
mistakes: Rounding the upper back at the bottom.

text.setup: Sit on the bench with feet on the foot plates and knees slightly bent. Grip the handle with straight arms and sit tall.
cues: Pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together, then let them slide forward on the return.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth to move the weight.

text.setup: Set a handle at chest height. Stand side-on in a split stance facing the machine, holding the handle in one hand with the arm straight.
cues: Row to the ribs without letting the hips or shoulders twist.
Return slowly to a long arm.
mistakes: Rotating the torso to finish the pull.

text.setup: Set a rope attachment at about forehead height. Grip the rope ends with thumbs pointing back and step back until the arms are straight.
cues: Pull the rope towards your face, spreading the ends apart.
Finish with hands beside your ears and elbows high.
mistakes: Using too much weight so the lower back leans back.

text.setup: Adjust the chest pad so you can just reach the handles with straight arms. Sit with your chest on the pad.
cues: Pull the handles back, driving the elbows behind you.
Return slowly to full stretch.
mistakes: Pulling the chest off the pad.

text.setup: Set a bar in a rack at about hip height. Lie underneath it, grip it just wider than shoulders and lift your body into a straight line from heels to head.
cues: Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower until arms are straight, keeping the body rigid.
Bend your knees to make it easier, or lower the bar to make it harder.
mistakes: Hips sagging as you pull.

text.setup: Anchor a band at chest height (or loop it around your feet while seated). Hold an end in each hand with arms straight.
cues: Row the hands to your ribs and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Letting the band snap back.

text.setup: Adjust the thigh pad so your legs are locked in. Grip the bar a little wider than shoulders and sit with arms straight.
cues: Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving the elbows down.
Lean back only slightly.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Leaning far back and rowing it down.

text.setup: Set a handle at the top of the cable column. Kneel on one knee facing the machine and grip the handle with the arm reaching up.
cues: Pull the elbow down to your side.
Let the arm return all the way up under control.
mistakes: Twisting the torso instead of pulling with the back.

text.setup: Anchor a band high on a door anchor or bar. Kneel facing it with an end in each hand and arms reaching up.
cues: Pull your elbows down towards your ribs.
Return slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up at the top.

text.setup: Choose an assistance weight (more weight means more help). Kneel on the pad and grip the handles above you with arms straight.
cues: Pull your chest towards the handles.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
mistakes: Choosing so much assistance that the set feels easy.

text.setup: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place one foot or knee in the loop. Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
cues: Pull your chest towards the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.
mistakes: Letting the band fling you up from the bottom.
text.safety: Check the band is secure and step out of it carefully at the end.

text.setup: Stand on a sturdy box or bench under the pull-up bar so you can grip it with your chin already above it.
cues: Step off and lower yourself slowly for 3 to 5 seconds.
Reach straight arms at the bottom, then step back up.
mistakes: Dropping quickly through the bottom half.

text.setup: Hang from the bar with hands slightly wider than your shoulders (palms away), or shoulder-width with palms facing you for a chin-up.
cues: Start by pulling your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging to get over the bar.
Half reps that stop short of straight arms.

text.setup: Wear a weight vest or a dip belt with a plate, then hang from the bar as for a normal pull-up.
cues: Keep the same full range as your bodyweight pull-ups.
Control the weight so it does not swing.
mistakes: Adding load before you can do 3 solid sets of 8 to 10 bodyweight pull-ups.
